notes: J-GAAP throughout FY2008-FY2026 (TEL has not adopted IFRS).

totalEquity = Total shareholders' equity + Accumulated other comprehensive income as printed on the consolidated balance sheet (the J-GAAP 'equity' that excludes share subscription rights and non-controlling interests; TEL defines Equity = Net assets - Subscription rights [- NCI]). It is the sum of two printed subtotals, not a single printed line.
totalDebt FY2008-FY2014 = short-term borrowings and commercial paper + current portion of long-term debt + long-term debt, summed from the printed Fact Book 2016 balance-sheet lines.
capex = 'Payment for purchase of property, plant and equipment' from the cash flow statement; intangible-asset purchases are a separate line and are excluded.
cashAndEquivalents = cash and cash equivalents at end of year (cash flow statement), which excludes time deposits and short-term securities.

3-for-1 stock split on 2023-04-01. EPS for FY2016-FY2023 in the IR2026 summary is split-adjusted (restated); dividends per share and shares outstanding for FY2023 and earlier are actual pre-split amounts as printed. FY2008-FY2015 EPS from AR2015 is pre-split (not adjusted) - divide by 3 for comparability.
sharesOutstanding = number of shares issued at fiscal year end (including treasury stock), as printed.
FY2015 net sales: Tokyo Electron Device became an equity-method affiliate from FY2015 (electronic components segment dropped).
